preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 100,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{xi} {li}' for xi, li in parts)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of nonempty parts followed by the start and length of each part.

postconditions.expression: sum(li for xi, li in parts) == max_length
postconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of the output parts must equal the maximum possible length of the password.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(stdin) for xi, li in parts) and all(li > 0 for xi, li in parts)
postconditions.description: All start positions must be valid and all lengths must be positive.
